name: Rockville
source:
“...Too many things end up meaningless in this world.”

Unit: Offense Black, 2nd Squad
Rank: Address

A strategist who serves as Fomalhaut's right hand, commanding the front lines.
Once a man of admirable personality, he lost his former brightness after taking on a heavy burden.

His unnecessary kindness is evident in how sympathetically he treats Kazuhito and his friends after they are drawn into the Ruined World.

Class: ???
Reality-Altering Ability: Fanfare — an ability that forms battle lines by deploying familiars in the form of chess pieces. His tactics are flexible, exploiting the strengths of each piece.
